args: Set the Battery element's Discharge cost to a constant 0.01 $/kWh and saved it; the save reported success and the value reads back as 0.01 on reopening. However, HAEO also now shows a Policy named 'Battery discharge cost' (Source: Battery, Target: Any, Price: 0.01 $/kWh) that did not exist before my save. I did not create it deliberately and did not change it. If both are applied, battery discharge is charged 0.02 $/kWh, not 0.01. Please check whether the policy is a mirror of the battery field or a separate charge, and delete one of them if they stack.
